provenance: synthetic: figures written for this example; the B5 scripted harness emits the same `usage` steps and B3 serves /v1/usage and /control/usage. Nothing here was captured from a real harness or account.

behaviors.1: band shows fill and tightest window within 1 s of a usage report
behaviors.2: another task shows its own numbers; a task without usage shows no fill
behaviors.3: tone thresholds; one notice at 80% per task and crossing
behaviors.4: one request per interval through the declared connection; none while no task exists
behaviors.5: limits notice after a reply per the afterReply setting
behaviors.6: report panel data from the ledger recorded at each turn end
behaviors.7: context note above 70%, at most once per five minutes and three times per task
behaviors.8: start fresh needs two clicks; insert checkpoint writes the draft only
behaviors.9: clean up shown only where the harness can compact
behaviors.10: no grant, disable, safe mode: no band, no subscriptions
